name: Please, I Need Vacation!
source:
Step into the shoes of a protagonist who dreams of only one thing: making the most of their vacation. The problem? Well... they also work for Terravel. Will that stop them? Absolutely not. Nothing will stand in the way of eternal happiness, not even love... or will it?

[Translated from [url=https://moliahthy.itch.io/please-i-need-vacation]itch.io[/url]]
